description:
Searches workspaces published on Desky by city, neighborhood, type, capacity and price range. For each one it returns its id, name, coworking, location, starting price with its unit (per day for desks and offices, per hour for rooms: see `price_from_period`), amenities and a ready-made booking URL.

It does not filter by availability: use `check_availability` for that.

Pass `capacity` if the person said how many people: it is used to filter AND to prefill the link with that number of seats. If they asked for a time slot for a room, pass `starts_at` and `ends_at` too: they prefill the link and the interface.

Prices are LIST prices per unit, never a total: the final price is calculated at checkout. That is context for you so you do not present them as a total; there is no need to point it out to the person in every reply.

capacity.description: Minimum number of people the space must fit.

currency.description: Currency of `price_min`/`price_max` and of the returned prices (default usd). Prices are converted and rounded the same way as on desky.la; the filter compares before rounding, so a result can fall up to one rounding step outside the requested range.

date.description: Tentative date YYYY-MM-DD. It does NOT filter by availability: it is used to prefill the booking link. To know if the space is free, use `check_availability`.

ends_at.description: End time HH:MM. Requires `starts_at` and must be later.

space_type.description: Space type. `day_pass` is a desk in a shared area; `private_office` a closed office; `meeting_room` a room booked by the hour.

starts_at.description: Start time HH:MM the person asked for. Only meaningful for spaces sold by the hour (meeting rooms); requires `ends_at`. It does NOT filter by availability: it prefills the booking link and the interface.

utm_source.description: MCP client that originates the request, for attribution of the booking URLs (e.g. 'claude', 'chatgpt'). Default 'mcp_unknown'.

zone.description: Neighborhood within the city (e.g. 'Palermo'). If the neighborhood can be resolved, results are LIMITED to it; otherwise it is combined with `city` as free text and the results may be broader.

name: search_coworks

id.description: Space identifier. Pass it as `space_id` to `cowork_detail`, `check_availability` or `get_booking_link`.

opening_hours.description: Opening hours of the venue. Empty if not provided.

price_from_period.description: Whether `price_from` is per day or per hour.

title: Search workspaces
